    c.XCL_002 AS card_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM legalities l 
            WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072 
            AND l.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
        ) THEN 'Banned' 
        ELSE 'Not Banned' 
    END AS ban_status
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082

    c.XCL_003 = 'Allen Williams'
    AND fd.XCL_076 = 'Japanese'
    AND (c.XCL_004 IS NULL OR c.XCL_004 = '*')
